name: pwgen_help
description: Explain pwgen command-line flags and options in human-readable detail.

flags.description: CLI flag string to explain (e.g. '-sy', '-0ABv'). If omitted or empty, explains all available pwgen flags.

execution.code: const input = typeof $PIPE_DATA !== 'undefined' && $PIPE_DATA ? JSON.parse($PIPE_DATA) : {}; const requestId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const cmd = new BroadcastChannel('pwgen-commands'); const res = new BroadcastChannel('pwgen-results'); const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { const t = setTimeout(() => { res.close(); resolve('Timed out \u2014 pwgen page may not be loaded yet.'); }, 12000); res.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data && e.data.requestId === requestId) { clearTimeout(t); res.close(); resolve(e.data.result); } }; cmd.postMessage({ type: 'pwgen_help', requestId, params: { flags: input.flags || input.rawInput || '' } }); cmd.close(); }); return result;
